_comment: train_vae_multimodal.py. Recipe of checkpoints/vaev2_multimodal/kl5e5_from_epoch10 (the conditioning VAE used by the bridge). Its notebook no longer exists: optimiser, scheduler, KL ramp and alignment weight were recovered from the checkpoint and training.jsonl, the patch size (96^3) from the author.
_run_name_comment: the run is written to checkpoints/rebuild/vae_multimodal/<run_name>; the thesis checkpoint folder is protected

data._steps_comment: 455 training patients x 8 = 3640 steps per epoch, matching training.jsonl

model._patch_size_comment: the model's TILE size for whole-volume encode/decode, as stored with the thesis checkpoint; the training crops come from data.patch_size

loss._kl_comment: linear ramp 1e-6 -> 5e-5 over epochs 5-55; reproduces every kl_weight in training.jsonl
